message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large white letters. Against a light grey background with red borders, a central collage of illustrated figures is framed by stylized red and yellow flame-like shapes and white clouds.

Ten human figures in athletic poses are depicted. In the center, a man bites a gold medal. To his left, a woman in a white and red sports top looks forward. To his right, a woman wearing a black headscarf and a man with a slight smile are visible. Below them, a shirtless man salutes, while another woman in a white hat and shirt is positioned to the right. Smaller figures around the perimeter engage in sports like badminton, tennis, karate, and sprinting. The figures wear red and white athletic clothing, consistent with the overall color scheme.

Yellow text reads "YO YO AYO" in large letters, with a black banner underneath containing the white text: "SUKSES DI ASIAN GAMES, INDONESIA HARUS BERSIAP MENGHADAPI OLIMPIADE TOKYO 2020." Top headlines include "PENUMPANG GELAP GERAKAN GANTI PRESIDEN" and "OPERASI JANGGAL MEMBURU BEGAL." A barcode and price are in the bottom right corner.
